index_record.dataset_generation_caption: The figure presents an overview of a reinforcement learning (RL) framework structured as a roadmap, emphasizing the interplay between search and learning components under the overarching RL process. The global layout is vertically organized into three main sections: at the top, 'Reward Design' is represented as a light pink rectangular box; at the bottom, 'Policy Initialization' is similarly styled; and in the center, a large dashed rectangular boundary encloses the core 'Reinforcement Learning' module, which contains the primary workflow. This central module is horizontally divided into two main red rectangular blocks labeled 'Search' on the left and 'Learning' on the right, connected by bidirectional curved arrows. These arrows are colored red and labeled: the top arrow is marked 'Data', flowing from Search to Learning, while the bottom arrow is labeled 'Policy', flowing from Learning to Search. Positioned centrally between these two blocks is a small icon of a strawberry followed by the text 'o1', suggesting a specific model or agent instance within the RL loop. A solid black arrow descends from 'Reward Design' to the top edge of the dashed RL boundary, indicating that reward design informs the entire RL process. Similarly, a solid black arrow ascends from 'Policy Initialization' to the bottom edge of the dashed boundary, showing that initial policy parameters are fed into the RL loop. The visual modules are distinct in color and shape: 'Reward Design' and 'Policy Initialization' are light pink rectangles with black borders and bold black text; 'Search' and 'Learning' are dark red rectangles with white bold text; the central 'o1' label and strawberry icon are rendered in red and green respectively, with the text 'o1' in red. The connections are clearly directional, with curved red arrows forming a feedback loop between Search and Learning, and straight black arrows establishing top-down and bottom-up dependencies from external components. The figure’s caption states it illustrates the roadmap including policy initialization, reward design, search, and learning, aligning with the visual structure. No mathematical equations or LaTeX expressions are present in the diagram itself.
